mapper.select: SELECT session_id, execution_id, root_event_id, state, current_segment_id, pending_tool_call_id, pending_plan_event_id, pending_question_event_id, stop_event_id, terminal_event_id, UPPER(terminal_reason) AS terminal_reason, created_at, updated_at, terminal_at FROM t_session_executions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT session_id, execution_id, root_event_id, state, current_segment_id, pending_tool_call_id, pending_plan_event_id, pending_question_event_id, stop_event_id, terminal_event_id, UPPER(terminal_reason) AS terminal_reason, created_at, updated_at, terminal_at FROM t_session_executions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND state <> 'TERMINAL' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_session_executions SET state = 'STOPPING', stop_event_id = #{stopEventId}, pending_tool_call_id = CASE WHEN pending_plan_event_id IS NULL AND pending_question_event_id IS NULL THEN pending_tool_call_id ELSE NULL END, pending_plan_event_id = NULL, pending_question_event_id = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} AND current_segment_id = #{segmentId} AND state IN ('RUNNING', 'CONFIRMING') AND stop_event_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT entry.session_id, entry.id AS entry_id, entry.entry_seq, entry.parent_id AS entry_parent_id, entry.type AS entry_type, entry.timestamp AS entry_timestamp, entry.payload AS entry_payload, event.event_id, event.event_seq, event.anchor_entry_id, event.type AS event_type, event.created_at, event.payload AS event_payload FROM t_session_executions execution JOIN t_session_execution_segment_events segment_event ON segment_event.session_id = execution.session_id AND segment_event.execution_id = execution.execution_id AND segment_event.segment_id = #{target.segmentId} AND segment_event.event_id = execution.terminal_event_id JOIN t_session_events event ON event.session_id = execution.session_id AND event.event_id = execution.terminal_event_id AND event.event_seq = segment_event.event_seq JOIN t_session_entries entry ON entry.session_id = event.session_id AND entry.id = event.anchor_entry_id WHERE execution.session_id = #{target.sessionId} AND execution.execution_id = #{target.executionId} AND execution.root_event_id = #{target.rootEventId} AND execution.current_segment_id = #{target.segmentId} AND execution.state = 'TERMINAL' AND execution.terminal_event_id = #{terminalEventId} AND execution.terminal_reason = #{terminalReason}
